bear_case: The HOLD upgrade rests on two data points — 30Y Day-2 at 4.96% and Brent at $96.97 — both of which are one session old and reversible within hours of a hot NFP print or an Iran headline. The ADP/JOLTS/ISM Prices data stack (ADP 122K, JOLTS 7.6M, ISM Services Prices 71.3% — highest since August 2022) argues for meaningful upside NFP surprise risk that the 65-125K consensus does not fully price. AVGO's two-session 15% decline is the first systematic repricing of AI infrastructure multiples in this cycle; if the guidance-plateau template spreads to NVDA's next earnings (late July), the NVDA long — the framework's primary risk-on thesis — becomes a liability. BTC's plunge below pre-war levels is a leading risk-appetite indicator that the Dow's record close masks. Invalidation: if NFP prints above 165K AND the 30Y closes above 5.00% on Friday, revert HOLD to STEP ASIDE immediately — close XLF, pause NVDA add, tighten NVDA stop to $218.
